name: MaxSellora – AI Chat That Converts Visitors to Buyers

sections.description:
Right now, most visitors are leaving your store without buying.

Not because they don’t want your products — but because they couldn’t
find the right one fast enough, or no one was there to answer the one
question standing between them and checkout.

Every one of those visitors is a sale you already paid to acquire.

MaxSellora makes sure you stop losing them.

A smart AI assistant appears at the right moment, answers instantly,
recommends the perfect product, and walks your visitor straight to
checkout — exactly like your best salesperson would. Except MaxSellora
works 24/7, replies in your customer’s own language, by text or voice,
and never has a bad day.

💬 “It’s like having a sales rep on every product page at once — for free.”

It took real engineering to make that feel effortless: live WooCommerce
catalog reading, 99+ language voice recognition, real-time stock and
order lookups, and human-handoff that never drops a conversation. You
get all of it behind a single switch.

The stores already using MaxSellora report:
→ Support emails dropping from 23/day to 2–3/day
→ Response time going from 4+ hours to 1.4 seconds
→ Zero missed conversations — including weekends and overnight

👉 One thing to do next: click Activate Free Plan. No credit card. No setup.

🆓 Start free. The gift is real, not a trial trap.

Activate the Free plan with one click and get 10 AI-powered
messages to try the assistant on your own store — or skip AI entirely
and run MaxSellora as a free live-chat platform for as long as you like.

Turn on Operators-only mode (Settings → Features) and every chat goes
straight to your team with no AI message quota and no paid subscription
required, ever. You still keep the full professional operator toolkit:
live inbox, Telegram & Slack bots, email alerts, read receipts,
multi-language widget — all free.

When you’re ready for AI, leave Operators-only off or upgrade for higher
message limits. You decide how much automation your store needs.

🚀 One-click setup. Zero configuration.

Install → Connect → Done. MaxSellora reads your WooCommerce catalog
automatically — no manual setup, no complicated settings, no developer
needed. Most stores are live in under 3 minutes.

🧠 Sells like a human. Scales like a machine.

  • Understands natural language — customers type like they talk
  • Recommends products based on what the customer actually needs
  • Compares items side by side on request
  • Checks real-time stock availability
  • Tracks order status and shipping instantly
  • Adds products to cart directly from the chat
  • Answers about the product the customer is currently viewing — without them having to name it

💡 What changes when you add MaxSellora to your store

✅ Recover sales that would otherwise be lost — AI answers buying questions instantly, 24/7, even at 2:00 AM on weekends
✅ Reduce repetitive support requests by up to 80% — let AI handle the common questions so your team can focus on customers who really need human help
✅ Increase average order value automatically — intelligent upsell and cross-sell recommendations built into every conversation
✅ Keep shoppers engaged before they leave — answer questions at the right moment to reduce abandoned visits and missed opportunities
✅ Let customers talk instead of type — voice chat lets shoppers ask questions naturally and hear spoken answers, completely hands-free
✅ Free unlimited human live chat — switch to Operators-only mode and route every conversation directly to your team, with no AI credits required
✅ Automatically switch between AI and human support — schedule Operators-only mode for business hours, evenings, weekends, or any custom timetable
✅ Instant human takeover — transfer any conversation from AI to a live operator with a single click, without interrupting the customer
✅ Start chatting immediately — optionally remove the name and email form so visitors can ask their first question without extra steps
✅ Reply from Telegram — answer customers, receive notifications, and manage conversations without opening your dashboard
✅ Reply from Slack — manage the same live inbox and receive instant notifications directly inside Slack
✅ Matches your store automatically — choose between elegant Glass or Classic styles that blend naturally with your website
✅ Perfect on every device — responsive fullscreen experience on mobile with smooth scrolling and zero layout issues
✅ Privacy-friendly by design — GDPR-ready with an automatic privacy policy snippet and no visitor data stored inside WordPress

🤖 What your customers can ask — and get a real answer to

Customers can ask things like:

  • “Which product is best for beginners?”
  • “What’s the difference between these two products?”
  • “Is this item in stock?”
  • “Where is my order?”
  • “Can you recommend something cheaper?”

MaxSellora reads your live WooCommerce catalog to give accurate, specific
answers — not generic chatbot responses that send customers back to Google.

🌍 Multi-language, out of the box

MaxSellora detects the language your visitor writes or speaks and
replies in that same language — French, Spanish, Turkish, Chinese,
Portuguese, and many more. There is no fixed “four language” limit on AI answers.

  • AI chat — auto-detects each message and responds in the customer’s language (typed or voice)
  • Voice chat — OpenAI Whisper recognizes 99+ spoken languages with no extra setup
  • Widget UI — buttons, placeholders, and chrome translated for English · Persian (Farsi) · Arabic · German (from your WordPress locale; other locales use English labels while the AI still answers in the visitor’s language)

🎙️ Voice Chat — let customers talk, not type

Some shoppers would rather speak than type — especially on mobile.
With AI Voice Chat, your customer just taps the microphone, asks out
loud, and MaxSellora listens, understands, and answers back in a warm,
natural voice. It’s the closest thing to a real conversation with your
best salesperson.

  • 🎤 Tap-to-talk microphone built right into the chat widget — no app needed
  • 🗣️ Speech-to-text powered by OpenAI Whisper — 99+ languages auto-detected, no setup
  • 🔊 Lifelike spoken replies (OpenAI text-to-speech)
  • ▶️ A real audio player on every voice message — play, pause, and scrub back and forth
  • 📱 Hands-free and accessibility-friendly, perfect for mobile shoppers
  • 📲 Fully responsive widget — on phones the chat opens edge-to-edge (fullscreen), with a prominent minimize control to return to the store
  • 🎚️ One simple toggle: WooCommerce → MaxSellora → Settings → Voice Chat

Voice chat is off by default — flip the switch whenever you’re ready
to give your store a voice.

👥 Operators-only mode — full human support, zero cost

Sometimes you want every conversation handled by your team — no AI at all.
With Operators-only mode, new chats skip the AI from the first message
and go straight to your human operators.

  • 🚫 AI never replies while this mode is on
  • 👤 Every new chat starts in the operator queue immediately
  • 🔒 Customers cannot switch back to AI from the widget
  • 🎙️ Voice chat is disabled automatically in this mode
  • ⏰ Schedule it — set a From/To time window (e.g. 22:00–08:00) and it switches on and off automatically using your site’s timezone. Overnight windows supported.
  • ⚙️ One toggle: WooCommerce → MaxSellora → Settings → Features
  • 🔄 Stays in sync between your WordPress admin and MaxSellora dashboard

Free, forever: No paid plan needed. Enable Operators-only mode on the
free account and your store gets a professional live-chat widget plus the
full operator toolkit — dashboard inbox, Telegram Mini App, Slack,
notifications, read receipts, and handoff controls — without consuming
AI credits or paying a subscription.

🎨 Widget Appearance

Make the chat feel like part of your store, not a bolt-on:

  • Classic (solid) or Glass (transparent) panel style — frosted, modern look
  • Adjustable transparency — slider from 5% to 60% for the glass effect
  • Custom launcher icon — replace the default bubble with your own image
  • Font source — Google Font (Inter) or your site’s theme font
  • Font size — scale 80–130% to match your typography
  • Panel size (desktop) — scale 70–120% width and height
  • Teaser message — up to 72 characters above the closed bubble, in Card, Mini chat box, or Speech bubble style, with a dismiss button
  • Widget position — bottom-left or bottom-right
  • Widget color — match your brand

Plans & Pricing

  • Paid plans — Higher or unlimited AI message quotas for stores that
    want AI answering customers at volume. Manage from your dashboard at
    https://woocommerce.chatbot.shop-aiplugin.com.
  • Free plan — 10 AI-powered messages included (lifetime total),
    or unlimited human-only live chat when Operators-only mode is
    enabled (AI off). No paid upgrade required for operator-only use.
  • Demo mode — For testing only. Runs in mock mode on your server;
    no data is sent to the API and no real AI is involved.

Most stores start on the Free plan, try the AI on real visitors, then
move up only when the sales it brings in justify a paid quota.

Human Operator Support (all plans — free with Operators-only mode)

Operators can start a chat with any customer at any time, or customers
can request a human at any point. When an AI plan limit is reached, the
chat is handed off automatically — no customer is ever left without support.

With Operators-only mode enabled from day one, you run a complete
live-support setup on the free plan: storefront chat widget, operator
inbox, Telegram bot & Mini App, Slack integration, and new-chat email
alerts — without using AI or buying a paid subscription.

Manage operators, roles, and live conversations from your MaxSellora
dashboard at https://woocommerce.chatbot.shop-aiplugin.com.

Telegram operator bot

Connect your team to the official MaxSellora Telegram bot
(@MaxSellorabot) so operators can work without keeping the dashboard open:

  • Instant alerts when a shopper starts a new chat or requests a human
  • View the same conversation list and message history as the web inbox
  • Reply to customers directly from Telegram
  • Take over a chat from AI or hand it back to AI with inline actions
  • Link each operator’s Telegram user ID in Operators (dashboard)

Slack operator bot

If your store runs on Slack, operators can use the same live-chat workflow there:

  • Notifications for new chats and human-handoff requests
  • Browse and open customer conversations from Slack
  • Send operator replies without leaving Slack
  • Link each operator’s Slack member ID in Operators (dashboard)

Telegram and Slack are optional — the web dashboard inbox always works.
Configure operator IDs and notification preferences per team member in
the MaxSellora panel.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or higher
  • PHP 8.0 or higher

Ready in one click: install, then Activate Free Plan. Your store
starts selling for itself today.

External Services

This plugin sends data to one external API endpoint.

Endpoint:
https://woocommerce.chatbot.shop-aiplugin.com

Data sent:
* Chat message text
* Session identifier (stored in browser localStorage)
* Page URL
* Visitor IP address
* Customer name and email (when provided in the guest form or from a logged-in WooCommerce account)
* Voice recordings — only when Voice Chat is enabled and the visitor records a message; the audio is sent for speech-to-text transcription, and the AI reply text is sent back for text-to-speech
* WooCommerce product data (title, description, price, stock, SKU, categories, attributes, gallery URLs, language) — sent only when the merchant runs Reindex Products or saves a product

When data is sent:
* Only when a visitor sends a chat message while the widget is active
* Only when the merchant manually triggers a product reindex
* No data is ever sent in Demo mode

Privacy policy: https://shop-aiplugin.com/privacy
Terms of service: https://shop-aiplugin.com/terms

Privacy

What personal data does this plugin collect?

The plugin does not store visitor data in your WordPress database. When a visitor
uses the chat widget, the following data may be transmitted to
https://woocommerce.chatbot.shop-aiplugin.com: chat message text, page URL,
visitor IP address, optionally the customer’s name and email (from the guest form
or a logged-in WooCommerce account), and a session identifier stored in the
browser’s localStorage.

In Demo mode, no data is transmitted anywhere.

What about WooCommerce product data?

When the merchant runs Reindex Products (or saves a product while the plugin
is connected), the plugin sends WooCommerce product data — title, description,
price, stock, SKU, categories, attributes, gallery URLs, and language — to the
MaxSellora API so the assistant can answer product questions accurately.

How do I declare this in my privacy policy?

The plugin automatically registers a suggested privacy snippet via
wp_add_privacy_policy_content(). You can copy it into your site’s privacy policy
from Tools → Privacy → Policy Guide.
Full upstream policy: https://shop-aiplugin.com/privacy

How do I delete a customer’s chat history?

Go to Conversations → Delete in the MaxSellora dashboard. This covers GDPR
right-to-erasure requests. Deactivating the plugin immediately stops all further
data transmission.

License and Legal

This plugin is licensed under GPLv2 or later and is fully GPL-compatible.
The MaxSellora SaaS backend is a proprietary service governed by the Terms of
Service at https://shop-aiplugin.com/terms.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the maxsellora folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install through the WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → MaxSellora.

Recommended — Automatic setup (Free plan):

Click Activate Free Plan. The plugin configures itself automatically:
API connection, dashboard link, and WooCommerce REST API keys are all set
up without any manual steps. When your free plan messages are used up,
purchase a paid plan from your MaxSellora dashboard — all existing settings
carry over and everything keeps working with no reconfiguration needed.

Alternative — Manual setup:

  1. Create an Account — Go to https://woocommerce.chatbot.shop-aiplugin.com and create your admin account.
  2. Add a Store — Navigate to Stores in the sidebar and click Add Store.
  3. Get WooCommerce API Keys — In WordPress: WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API → Add Key → Read/Write → copy Consumer Key and Secret.
  4. Generate a MaxSellora API Key — In the MaxSellora dashboard: API Keys → create a new key → copy it.
  5. Configure the Plugin — In WordPress: WooCommerce → MaxSellora → paste the API Key.
  6. Click Save Changes, then Test Connection.
  7. Index Your Products — Click Reindex Products to sync your WooCommerce catalog with the AI engine.

Tip: After adding new products, click Reindex Products again to keep
the AI current. Products also sync automatically when you save a product in WooCommerce.

To try without signing up, enable Demo mode from WooCommerce → MaxSellora.
Demo mode runs entirely on your server — no data is ever sent anywhere.
sections.faq:
How many sales am I losing without a chat assistant?

Every visitor who leaves with an unanswered question is a sale you already
paid to acquire. The stores using MaxSellora report support emails dropping
from 23/day to 2–3, and response time falling from 4+ hours to 1.4 seconds.

MaxSellora answers that question in real time, recommends the right product,
and guides the shopper to checkout — so fewer of those visitors slip away.
Activate the Free plan and see it work on your own traffic. No credit card needed.

What is Demo mode?

Demo mode is for testing only — not a preview of real AI features.

Responses are pre-defined and run locally on your server. No data is sent
externally and no actual AI is involved.

To experience real product recommendations, order tracking, and AI-powered
chat, activate the Free plan — no credit card needed.

What is included in the Free plan?

The Free plan includes 10 AI-powered messages in total (lifetime). Once
that limit is reached, all new conversations route automatically to your
human operators — no conversation is dropped.

Alternatively, enable Operators-only mode and use MaxSellora as a full
live-chat platform with no AI messages consumed and no paid plan required.

What happens when an AI plan limit is reached?

The customer is seamlessly transferred to a human operator. No error is
shown and no conversation is dropped. If no operator is online, the customer
sees your configured offline message.

Do I need an account to use the plugin?

You need a MaxSellora account to use AI features and human operator management.
Demo mode is available without an account. Sign up and connect your store from
WooCommerce → MaxSellora — it takes about 2 minutes.

Can I customize the chat widget?

Yes. Under WooCommerce → MaxSellora → Settings you can change: widget
color, position (bottom-left or bottom-right), chat panel style (Classic
solid or a frosted Glass/transparent look with an adjustable transparency
slider), custom launcher icon (image URL), font (Google Font Inter or
your theme font), font size (80–130%), panel size on desktop (70–120%),
and an optional teaser message (up to 72 characters) with three display
styles (card, mini chat box, or speech bubble) and a dismiss button.

Is the chat widget responsive on mobile?

Yes. On phones and small screens the widget opens fullscreen — messages,
product cards, and the input area are all easy to use. A clear minimize button
returns the visitor to your store at any time. No layout or overflow issues
on any device.

Can operators and customers send images in live chat?

Yes — during human operator chat only, not while the AI is replying. Operators
and customers can send images up to 3 MB from the storefront widget, the
MaxSellora dashboard inbox, and the Telegram Mini App. Image upload is hidden
automatically during AI-only conversations.

Do messages show read receipts like WhatsApp or Telegram?

Yes. During live operator chat, sent messages show delivery ticks in the widget,
dashboard inbox, and Telegram Mini App: one tick when sent, two ticks
when the other party has read the message. Read state syncs in real time across
all devices.

Can operators edit their messages?

Yes. Operators can edit their own text messages from the Live Chat inbox in
the MaxSellora dashboard and from the Telegram Mini App. Edited messages are
marked as edited for the customer.

Does it support multiple languages?

Yes. The AI auto-detects the language of each customer message and responds in
that language — shoppers can write (or speak, with Voice Chat) in virtually any
language, not just a short preset list.

Widget UI labels are translated for English, Persian (Farsi), Arabic, and German.
Other locales fall back to English labels while AI replies still match the
customer’s language.

Can customers talk to the chatbot with their voice?

Yes — that’s AI Voice Chat. Enable it from Settings → Voice Chat and a
microphone button appears in the widget. Shoppers tap to record a question;
MaxSellora transcribes it (OpenAI Whisper, 99+ languages auto-detected), answers,
and speaks the reply back with a natural voice.

Every voice message includes a built-in audio player (play, pause, seek). The
button only appears on browsers that support microphone recording. Each voice
exchange uses 3 plan credits; a typed message uses 1. Voice chat is unavailable
when Operators-only mode is enabled.

Can I use MaxSellora for free without buying a paid plan?

Yes. Activate the Free plan (one click, no credit card).

Enable Operators-only mode and the AI stays off — your team handles every
chat without consuming AI messages or needing a paid subscription. You still
get: live chat widget, operator dashboard, Telegram bot & Mini App, Slack
integration, and all notification controls.

Paid plans are only needed when you want AI to answer customers automatically
at higher volume.

Can I disable AI and use only human operators?

Yes. Enable Operators-only mode from WooCommerce → MaxSellora →
Settings → Features, or from Settings in your MaxSellora dashboard.
When active:

  • AI never replies — new chats go straight to operators from the first message
  • Customers cannot switch back to AI from the widget
  • Voice chat is disabled automatically
  • The setting syncs between WordPress and your dashboard
  • Works on the free plan — no upgrade required

You can also schedule it automatically: set a From/To time range in
Settings → Features and Operators-only switches on and off by itself —
for example, 22:00–08:00 every night. Overnight windows are supported.
The schedule overrides the manual toggle while enabled.

Can I let visitors chat without filling in name and email first?

Yes. The Guest contact form is on by default — first-time guests see a
short name/email step before chatting. To skip that and let visitors start typing
immediately, turn it off from Settings → Features or your MaxSellora dashboard.
The toggle syncs automatically when your store is connected. Logged-in WooCommerce
customers never see the form; their account details are used instead.

How do I sync products?

Go to WooCommerce → MaxSellora and click Reindex Products. Products also
sync automatically when you create or update a product in WooCommerce.

How do I add human operators?

Log in at https://woocommerce.chatbot.shop-aiplugin.com, go to Operators,
and add your team members. Operators can chat with customers at any time from
the dashboard.

Can operators use Telegram or Slack?

Yes. In the dashboard Operators screen, add each person’s Telegram user ID
and/or Slack member ID and enable notifications. They can then receive alerts and
reply to shoppers from Telegram (@MaxSellorabot) or Slack, with the same
take-over and hand-back controls as the web inbox.

External Services

This plugin sends data to one external API endpoint.

Endpoint:
https://woocommerce.chatbot.shop-aiplugin.com

Data sent:
* Chat message text
* Session identifier (stored in browser localStorage)
* Page URL
* Visitor IP address
* Customer name and email (when provided in the guest form or from a logged-in WooCommerce account)
* Voice recordings — only when Voice Chat is enabled and the visitor records a message; the audio is sent for speech-to-text transcription, and the AI reply text is sent back for text-to-speech
* WooCommerce product data (title, description, price, stock, SKU, categories, attributes, gallery URLs, language) — sent only when the merchant runs Reindex Products or saves a product

When data is sent:
* Only when a visitor sends a chat message while the widget is active
* Only when the merchant manually triggers a product reindex
* No data is ever sent in Demo mode

Privacy

What personal data does this plugin collect?

The plugin does not store visitor data in your WordPress database. When a visitor
uses the chat widget, the following data may be transmitted to
https://woocommerce.chatbot.shop-aiplugin.com: chat message text, page URL,
visitor IP address, optionally the customer’s name and email (from the guest form
or a logged-in WooCommerce account), and a session identifier stored in the
browser’s localStorage.

In Demo mode, no data is transmitted anywhere.

What about WooCommerce product data?

When the merchant runs Reindex Products (or saves a product while the plugin
is connected), the plugin sends WooCommerce product data — title, description,
price, stock, SKU, categories, attributes, gallery URLs, and language — to the
MaxSellora API so the assistant can answer product questions accurately.

How do I declare this in my privacy policy?

The plugin automatically registers a suggested privacy snippet via
wp_add_privacy_policy_content(). You can copy it into your site’s privacy policy
from Tools → Privacy → Policy Guide.
Full upstream policy: https://shop-aiplugin.com/privacy

How do I delete a customer’s chat history?

Go to Conversations → Delete in the MaxSellora dashboard. This covers GDPR
right-to-erasure requests. Deactivating the plugin immediately stops all further
data transmission.
